title: Market scan
description: What the optional web scan returns: who already does this and where the first customers gather. Every row carries a link read during the scan. Sent as-is to the model as the structured output format, so it uses only the subset structured outputs accept. Limits are enforced by scripts/schema.mjs (SCAN_LIMITS).

searchedAt.description: ISO date of the scan, YYYY-MM-DD.

queries.description: Up to 8 search queries actually run.

statusQuo.description: Up to 3 things the customer does today without a product (a notebook, a spreadsheet, a group chat, nothing).

competitors.description: Up to 8 products or services that solve the same problem for a similar customer. Never an article, a list, a review site or a platform that only hosts such tools.

url.description: The product's own home page, as seen in the search results.

kind.description: direct: same problem, same customer. adjacent: a general tool the customer could bend to the job.

forWhom.description: Who the product says it is for, in a few words.

price.description: The entry price exactly as published, with currency and period. Empty when it was not read on a page.

priceUrl.description: The page the price was read from. Empty when price is empty.

difference.description: One sentence: how the idea differs from this product, from the customer's point of view.

communities.description: Up to 5 public places where the target customers talk about the problem: a forum, a subreddit, a group, a trade association. Never a named person or a personal profile.

why.description: One sentence: why the customer is there and what to ask.

notes.description: What the scan could not settle, in at most two sentences. Empty when nothing applies.
